events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began on this day in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock! What's your favourite iconic performance from the legendary festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: We remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977, aged 42. He would have been 91 today.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll Tribute
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. Which of his hits is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: We remember influential rapper and actor Tupac Shakur, who passed away on this day in 1996, aged 25. He would have been 55 today.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we're reflecting on the powerful legacy of Tupac. Which of his tracks still resonates with you today?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We remember legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27. He would have been 84 today.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we're celebrating the unparalleled artistry of Jimi Hendrix. What's your favourite guitar moment from the legend?

events.title: 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969, featuring that famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'! That cover is as iconic as the tracks within. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are unmistakable. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: 'Imagine' single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a UK single. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant today as ever.

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod, launched 25 years ago today? It put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed everything. What was on your first iPod playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. What's the one song that always reminds you of him?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classics
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'! A double LP packed with classics. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, aged 45. He would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we're celebrating the incredible life and music of Freddie Mercury. What's your favourite Queen performance?
